userStories.title: The skin format, validator and validate CLI
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one validator that says exactly what Studio will accept.
acceptanceCriteria: spec/automatos-skin.v1.schema.json implementing PRD-259 §3 exactly (fields, allowed token names, value formats, fonts, shape ranges, mascot modes, size caps), with "x-status": "draft-until-studio-publishes" and the PRD-259 revision it follows

lib/skins/validate.ts: pure validator for skin.json + an asset manifest {path, bytes, sniffedType}: schema, allowed names only, HSL triplet or #rrggbb (hex normalised to triplets), the AA pairs (every text pair ≥ 4.5:1 per PRD-259 §3, ring on background ≥ 3:1) for each declared tone, woff2 magic bytes, webm/mp4/png sniffing, the size caps, no paths outside assets/, no unknown files, nothing of CSS/JS/SVG/HTML/URLs. Returns typed {ok, errors[{path, message}]} with plain-word messages
scripts/validate.ts + npm run validate <dir|file.autoskin> (tsx dependency pinned exactly): prints each error with its JSON path and exits non-zero on failure

scripts/sync-schema.ts + npm run sync-schema: fetches GET {AUTOMATOS_BACKEND_URL}/api/skins/schema or reads --from <automatos-ai checkout>/frontend/lib/skins/schema.ts output; writes spec/ and records the source; when neither is available it says so and changes nothing
Tests: a valid skin passes; each rule has a failing case with its message; a contrast failure names the pair and its ratio; hex normalisation
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Studio's base palettes and the skin engine
userStories.description: As a designer, I want to start from Studio's own look and see my changes applied exactly as Studio will.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/skins/base.ts: Studio's four token blocks (:root, .dark, .studio, .studio.dark) copied from the core's frontend/app/globals.css as data, with the core commit they came from in a comment; the derived aliases (paper, bg-1/2, fg/-2/-3) computed the way Studio derives them

lib/skins/css.ts: pure skinToCss(skin) producing the stylesheet PRD-259 §4 describes (html[data-skin] light tokens, html.dark[data-skin] dark tokens, --radius, --skin-glow, @font-face for skin fonts) from validated numbers only; a test proves a hostile value (e.g. '}body{', 'url(', '</style>') can never reach the output because only validated numbers are interpolated
lib/skins/model.ts: an immutable skin draft model (start from base studio or classic, set token per tone, fonts, shape, mascot, meta) with undo/redo history
lib/skins/suggest.ts: for a failing text pair, a suggested readable colour using readableOn (lib/looks/contrast.ts) generalised to arbitrary colours
Tests: base palettes match the core values for 5 sampled tokens; skinToCss output for a sample skin; suggestions pass AA

userStories.title: Pack, export, load into my Automatos, submit
userStories.description: As a developer, I want one file out, and a one-click way to try it in my Studio.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/skins/pack.ts with fflate (pinned exactly): skin.json + assets/ → <slug>-<version>.autoskin; unpack for import; both run the K-002 validator and refuse invalid input
scripts/pack.ts + npm run pack <dir> → dist/<slug>-<version>.autoskin, validating first
Editor: Export downloads the .autoskin; Import loads one (validated, plain-word errors)

Load into my Automatos: a server route POST /api/studio/import-skin that streams the packed file to {AUTOMATOS_BACKEND_URL}/api/skins/import with the lib/server/ proxy safety (Host, Sec-Fetch-Site, a required X-Skin-Kit: 1 header, size cap, raw body, long timeout); a 404 from the backend says 'Your Automatos doesn't support skins yet (it needs PRD-259)'
Submit to the Marketplace: POST /api/studio/submit-skin to {backend}/api/marketplace/skins the same way; on 404 the same message; the UI also offers 'Open my Automatos Marketplace' as a link
Tests: pack→unpack round-trips, pack refuses an invalid skin, the import route forwards bytes unchanged with the header check and maps 404 to the message
